# Settleezy

> Settleezy is a student-life platform for international students moving to and living in Berlin, Germany. It helps students cut their cost of living and handles the hard parts of settling in: verified student housing, Anmeldung (city registration) appointments, a discounted O2 student mobile plan, bank account and health insurance guidance, student discounts, and a community with events. Membership starts with a 30-day free trial, then costs €40 per semester or €70 per year.

Settleezy is for international (non-German) students at any university or college in Berlin, public or private. All content and support is in English.

## Key facts

- Website: https://settleezy.de
- Audience: international students in Berlin (before arrival and during studies)
- Language: English
- Free trial: 30 days
- Semester membership: €40 (one semester, about 6 months)
- Annual membership: €70 (12 months)
- What members get: verified housing support through Settleezy's accommodation partner Insider, Anmeldung appointment arrangement, the Settleezy–O2 student plan (unlimited mobile internet for €20/month), bank account and blocked account guidance (Expatrio, Coracle), health insurance guidance (TK, AOK, DAK, Barmer), Berlin student discounts, community events, and WhatsApp support

- [Public transport and the semester ticket in Berlin](https://settleezy.de/guides/public-transport-berlin-students/): Semesterticket vs Deutschlandticket
- [Health insurance for international students in Germany](https://settleezy.de/guides/health-insurance-students-germany/): Public vs private, costs, and the exemption trap
- [Cheapest SIM and mobile plans for students in Berlin](https://settleezy.de/guides/sim-card-berlin-students/): Prepaid vs contract, and the Settleezy–O2 plan
- [Student jobs in Berlin](https://settleezy.de/guides/student-jobs-berlin/): 140/280-day rule, minimum wage, minijobs, taxes
